full_judgment: VII. section 83A (5) was inserted by the Finance Act. 2003 which came into operation from 1st July, 2003. The said provision being not related to limitation the High Court Division erred in holding the Revenue Department cannot raise any claim in respect of assessment year 2002-2003 and thereby answering the question No. (e) in negative form.
